```artifact
Feature: Administrators Menu Screen to Maintain Doctors and Chemists/Labs

  Scenario: Add Doctor Screen
    Given the user is on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When the user clicks on the "Add Doctor" button
    Then the "Add Doctor Screen" is displayed with the following fields:
      | Field Name        | Field Type    | Field Value |
      | Doctor Id         | Generated     |             |
      | Doctor Name       | Text          |             |
      | Age               | Number        |             |
      | Sex               | Enum          |             |
      | Qualification     | Text          |             |
      | Experience        | Number        |             |

  Scenario: Edit/Update Doctor Screen
    Given the user is on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When the user clicks on the "Edit/Update Doctor" button
    Then the "Edit/Update Doctor Screen" is displayed with the following fields:
      | Field Name        | Field Type    | Field Value |
      | Doctor Id         | Generated     |             |
      | Doctor Name       | Text          |             |
      | Age               | Number        |             |
      | Sex               | Enum          |             |
      | Experience        | Number        |             |
      | Qualification     | Text          |             |

  Scenario: Add Chemist/Lab Screen
    Given the user is on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When the user clicks on the "Add Chemist/Lab" button
    Then the "Add Chemist/Lab Screen" is displayed with the following fields:
      | Field Name        | Field Type    | Field Value |
      | Chemist/Lab Id    | Generated     |             |
      | Chemist/Lab Flag  | Enum          |             |
      | Chemist Lab Name  | Text          |             |
      | Chemist Lab Address| Text          |             |
      | Chemist Lab Contact Details| Text          |             |

  Scenario: Edit/Update Chemist/Lab Screen
    Given the user is on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When the user clicks on the "Edit/Update Chemist/Lab" button
    Then the "Edit/Update Chemist/Lab Screen" is displayed with the following fields:
      | Field Name        | Field Type    | Field Value |
      | Chemist/Lab Id    | Generated     |             |
      | Chemist/Lab Flag  | Enum          |             |
      | Chemist Lab Name  | Text          |             |
      | Chemist Lab Address| Text          |             |
      | Chemist Lab Contact Details| Text          |             |

  Scenario: Add Doctor with existing Doctor Id
    Given the user is on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When the user clicks on the "Add Doctor" button with Doctor Id "123"
    Then an error message "Doctor does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario: Edit/Update Doctor with non-existent Doctor Id
    Given the user is on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When the user clicks on the "Edit/Update Doctor" button with Doctor Id "456"
    Then an error message "Doctor does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario: Delete Doctor with open Consultation Requests
    Given the user is on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When the user clicks on the "Delete Doctor" button with Doctor Id "789"
    Then an error message "Doctor has open Consultation Requests - cannot delete" is displayed

  Scenario: Add Chemist/Lab with existing Chemist/Lab Id
    Given the user is on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When the user clicks on the "Add Chemist/Lab" button with Chemist/Lab Id "101"
    Then an error message "Chemist/Lab does not exist" is displayed

  Scenario: Edit/Update Chemist/Lab with non-existent Chemist/Lab Id
    Given the user is on the Administrators Menu Screen
    When the user clicks on the "Edit/Update Chemist/Lab" button with Chemist/Lab Id "202"
    Then an error message "Chemist/Lab does not exist" is displayed
```
